problems.title: Algorithm9 unnormalized rank-area sum
problems.check: A_N=sum(U_(i)-i/N), E=-1/2, Var=N/12 for uniformPIT; grid gives-1/2 always.
problems.result: Literal estimator not normalized or consistent
problems.impact: Minor specification defect; published metric values not invalidated without provenance
problems.core_dependency: Empirical metric implementation unresolved; no evidence published curves used this pseudocode

correction.statement: For nested intervals use entry level V: V=U for lower one-sided, V=abs(2U-1) for equal-tailed. Exact signed empirical area is mean(V)-1/2; divide rank sum by N and use midpoint grid. Set entry level V=1 when the point never enters a credible set, which preserves the exact integral identity under misspecification.
correction.verification: Analytic integral identity; independent auxiliary challenge calculation. Intended interval semantics and historical implementation remain unresolved.

focused_check.note: Verified Algorithm 9's unnormalized rank sum has expectation -1/2 and variance N/12 under independent uniform PIT values. The main area definition instead averages interval-entry variables; one-sided U and equal-tailed |2U-1| conventions must be distinguished. The bounded normalization repair and intact main definition support Minor; historical metric implementation remains unknown.

problems.title: Separated supports need not induce uniform entropicOT
problems.claim: Disjoint-support mismatch will produce uniform transport and prior fallback
assumptions: Calibration lower-line matching can be exact while test upper-line parameter association is reversed; fine-tuning imposes no constraint on this OOD extension.
problems.check: h=(±R,0),g=(±R,R); CdiagR,Coff sqrt5R; q=logistic(R(sqrt5-1)/gamma); R10,gamma.5 givesq≈.999999999982.
problems.result: Increasing separation yields concentrated not uniform coupling
counterevidence: Gamma→infinity or flat costs do yielduniform
Paper presents heuristic outside primary iid scope
problems.core_dependency: Does not refute main iid empirical results

correction.statement: State fallback only under suitable cost geometry/regularization; any detector requires new validation

focused_check.note: Verified the exact unsquared Euclidean-cost two-by-two entropic-transport witness, with q=logistic(R(sqrt(5)-1)/gamma) tending to one rather than one half. Separated supports alone do not force uniform fallback. The main iid results are not disproved; Minor is confined to the unsupported distribution-shift extrapolation.
